info.name: Get an oEmbed response for a URL

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the resource for which to fetch oEmbed data.

params.name: maxwidth
params.description: The maximum width of the embed frame in pixels.

items.docs: The oEmbed 1.0 provider endpoint. Returns the oEmbed rich/link response for a bioaegistherapeutics.com URL. The sibling `/oembed/1.0/proxy` endpoint, which would fetch third-party URLs, returns 401 `rest_forbidden` anonymously.
